name: jev
description: Teaches an agent what Jev (TypeSafe's 'System One' model) is and when it belongs in a design: a fast, cheap, non-generative model that takes state plus a typed Choice/Score/Noul question and returns a typed answer with a calibrated probability distribution, for classification, routing, scoring, and confidence-gated automation — not for writing prose. Covers the three primitives' exact request/response shapes, how to read and threshold confidence, the documented architectural patterns, jev-1.13's known jaggedness (counting, dates, indirection, adversarial content, generation), and both the HTTP API and the JavaScript SDK. This plugin declares no MCP server: Jev has no official MCP integration, so a host's assistant cannot call it directly through chat yet. The skill exists for designing and writing code that calls Jev itself, authenticated with an API key (TYPESAFE_API_KEY, the documented SDK env var) the operator sets outside of chat.
author: Tovu

jini.summary: Helps you plan and write software that uses Jev, TypeSafe's fast AI model for sorting and scoring. Needs your own TypeSafe key.
